edge-entrypoint.sh.text:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
RATEFREAK_INGRESS_KEY="$(cat /run/ratefreak/ingress)"
export RATEFREAK_INGRESS_KEY
exec caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

compose.caddy.yaml.text:
services:
  caddy:
    image: ${RATEFREAK_CADDY_IMAGE:-caddy:2@sha256:ce773ec7a742ce15ee6bf2bb5f65882b9e2a4487b10733e6f1484f86e6b5d8bc}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports: ['80:80', '443:443']
    environment:
      RATEFREAK_PUBLIC_ORIGIN: ${RATEFREAK_PUBLIC_ORIGIN}
      RATEFREAK_CADDY_TLS: ${RATEFREAK_CADDY_TLS:-}
    entrypoint: [/bin/sh, /etc/ratefreak/edge-entrypoint.sh]
    volumes:
      - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
      - ./edge-entrypoint.sh:/etc/ratefreak/edge-entrypoint.sh:ro
      - ${RATEFREAK_INSTANCE_DIR}/runtime/web/ingress:/run/ratefreak/ingress:ro
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config
    networks: [ingress]
    depends_on:
      web: {condition: service_healthy}
volumes:
  caddy_data:
  caddy_config:
